title: desktop-notification telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the desktop-notification hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "desktop-notification". Evolves additive-only.

notification_type.description: The Claude Code notification type that triggered the hook (permission_prompt or idle_prompt).

channels.description: Channels that actually fired for this notification: any of bell, terminal_notify, os_toast. Empty array = nothing fired (envelope status is then skipped).
